escape_asterisks option escapes asterisks in plain text

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Use 2*3 = 6 in math.</p>', HtmlToMarkdownRs::ConversionOptions.new(escape_asterisks: true))
puts result.inspect
```
